title: Crystal glass
author: mlteenie
changes: Real recording of a crystal glass gently tapped with a soft object and ringing. Trimmed to 0.00–2.95 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording. The ring is faded out after about 2.9 s. No high-pass is applied because the clip has no measurable low-frequency rumble.
